title: Adjudicataire du consortium 2Africa pour la construction de la station d’atterrissement, Sonatel accueille le navire câblier pour la pose du câble 2Africa de la branche Dakar
lineage: Original publication on the issuing organisation’s website.

passages.locator: Dakar dateline, construction roles and technology paragraphs
passages.note: The Dakar landing station contractor describes the arrival of the installer’s vessel for branch works and identifies ASN’s SDM1 as the selected technology. Sonatel identifies itself as an Orange group member. The SDM1 statement is in the future tense and the report is not commissioning evidence.
